Definition: Jabets, the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The families of the scribes dwelt at Jabez. Jabez was more honourable than his brethren, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, because I bare him with sorrow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the town and the man share the name for a reason: the scribes dwelt at Jabez, and the man of Jabez prayed a prayer God granted, and sorrow named him but honour marked him.
